newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish police seek stolen rabbits, dead or alive.
newsitem.headline: Polish police seek stolen rabbits, dead or alive.

text.p: Polish authorities have issued a "dead or alive" wanted notice for four rabbits which were stolen from a laboratory and could harm anyone who eats them, the newspaper Gazeta Wyborcza said on Thursday.
It said the rabbits had vanished from the biology institute of a university in Torun in northern Poland after three had been injected with a substance used in research.

"Eating their meat could cause very serious disruption to the human organism and in this case emergency medical services should be notified," Torun police spokesman Boleslaw Sprengel told the best-selling daily.
"The Biology Institute has appealed to Torun residents to return the rabbits: dead or alive," the paper reported.
